OG-B12.from: Storage: Lithium battery bank (10-30kWh+), generator fuel reserve (diesel/petrol/LPG).
OG-B12.to: Storage: Battery bank (size it with the Battery Backup Planner) and a generator fuel reserve (see Using a generator safely).
OG-B12.reason: Removes the unsourced '10-30kWh+' (OG-19: size from household loads). OPTION A: removes 'diesel/petrol/LPG' — LPG raises GAS_SAFETY_REQUIRED and diesel FUEL_GUIDANCE_REQUIRED (the approved generator block covers petrol only). If this change is rejected, both checks hold OG-B12 in every market.

OG-B12.from: Distribution: 230V AC house panel, 48V DC lighting circuit, USB charging stations.
OG-B12.to: Distribution: How power reaches where you use it — for example the switchboard, any separate DC circuits and USB charging points. This is designed and installed by a licensed electrical worker.
OG-B12.reason: INSTALLATION DETAIL: '230V AC house panel, 48V DC lighting circuit' is system design. Kept as a planning concept; design and installation go to a licensed electrical worker (WorkSafe NZ).

OG-B12.from: Distribution: 230V AC house panel, 48V DC lighting circuit, USB charging stations.
OG-B12.to: Distribution: How power reaches where you use it — for example the switchboard, any separate DC circuits and USB charging points. This is designed and installed by a licensed electrician.
OG-B12.reason: As NZ, with the AU licence term (ESV; ESO Qld).

OG-B12.from: stream (with consent)
OG-B12.to: stream (check the water rules that apply)
OG-B12.reason: 'Consent' is NZ terminology; AU water rules vary by state and territory — no national rule.

OG-B12.from: Storage: Main tank (20,000L+), header tank (1,000L), emergency jerry cans (100L).
OG-B12.to: Storage: Main tank, header tank and emergency containers — sized to your household's use and your rainfall.
OG-B12.reason: Tank sizes (20,000L+, 1,000L, 100L) are unsourced and not per-person figures; the approved drinking-water block gives each market's own emergency minimum.

OG-B12.from: Greywater: Kitchen and shower water to mulch pits or subsurface irrigation (not on edible crops).
OG-B12.to: Greywater: Reuse options such as mulch pits or subsurface irrigation (not on edible crops). Rules vary, so check with your council before you set anything up.
OG-B12.reason: UNAPPROVED HAZARD (public health): greywater reuse is regulated locally. Kept as an option with its safety caveat; no instruction added.

OG-B12.from: Blackwater: Composting toilet, septic tank with leach field, or biogas digester.
OG-B12.to: Blackwater: Composting toilet or septic system. These need approval and professional design and installation — check with your council first.
OG-B12.reason: UNAPPROVED HAZARD: blackwater systems need approval and professional design. OPTION A removes 'biogas digester' (gas — GAS_SAFETY_REQUIRED).

OG-B12.from: Composting, burning (where permitted), recycling storage, landfill minimisation plan.
OG-B12.to: Composting, recycling storage, landfill minimisation plan.
OG-B12.reason: UNAPPROVED HAZARD: burning waste (fire risk, air rules, fire bans) has no approved NZ/AU guidance.

OG-B12.from: heat pump (if generator sized)
OG-B12.to: heat pump (check your power supply can run it)
OG-B12.reason: 'if generator sized' implied running a heat pump from a generator; no sizing rule is sourced.

OG-B12.from: Fuel: Firewood (3+ years cured), LPG, or diesel (store safely, rotate stock).
OG-B12.to: Fuel: Firewood — keep a dry store and rotate stock.
OG-B12.reason: '3+ years cured' is unsourced (the approved AU block says 'burn only dry, clean wood'). OPTION A removes LPG (gas appliance — GAS_SAFETY_REQUIRED) and diesel heating (no approved guidance).

OG-B12.from: Stored rainwater irrigates garden during drought. Greywater extends growing season.
OG-B12.to: Stored rainwater irrigates the garden during drought, and greywater can help where your council allows it.
OG-B12.reason: Greywater reuse is regulated locally.

OG-B12.from: Humanure composts (separately).
OG-B12.reason: UNAPPROVED HAZARD: composting human waste is a public-health risk with no approved guidance.

OG-B12.where: Integration — waste → soil (OPTION A: removes biogas)
OG-B12.from: Compost returns nutrients. Biogas provides cooking fuel. Closed loop achieved.
OG-B12.to: Compost returns nutrients to the garden.
OG-B12.reason: Biogas cooking fuel is gas (GAS_SAFETY_REQUIRED); 'Closed loop achieved' overstates.

OG-B12.from: Wood burner cooks and heats simultaneously.
OG-B12.to: A wood burner with a cooktop can cook and heat at the same time.
OG-B12.reason: Not every wood burner has a cooktop.

OG-B12.from: Inverter Capacity (kW) and Brand
OG-B12.to:
Inverter Output (kW) — a separate check from battery capacity (kWh)
 
Can the system supply backup power during an outage? (ask your installer)
OG-B12.reason: OG-19 rule: battery capacity (kWh) and power output (kW) are separate checks, and backup depends on the system. Brand dropped (category-based planning).

OG-B12.from: Consent Requirements (if any)
OG-B12.to: Permits or Approvals Needed (if any)
OG-B12.reason: 'Consent' is NZ terminology; AU requirements vary by state and territory.

OG-B12.from: Draw or describe your single-line energy and water flows.
OG-B12.to: Draw or describe your energy and water flows — a simple sketch for your own planning, not an electrical design.
OG-B12.reason: A 'single-line diagram' is an electrical design document; the member's sketch is not one.
